title: Denoising the US Census: Succinct Block Hierarchical Regression
abstract: arXiv:2603.10099v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The 2020 United States Census adopted differential privacy to protect individual confidentiality, adding calibrated noise to summary demographic measurements that are then reconciled into population tables. We developed BlueDown, a postprocessing algorithm that combines techniques from linear regression and constrained optimization while exploiting measurement structure for efficiency. On 2020 Census data, BlueDown reduced the error of groupings by race at the county level by 21-36% and of all county-level groupings by 9-58%; at the tract level, it reduced error of groupings by housing type by 38-61%. These gains came at no cost to confidentiality or computational efficiency, and would improve the validity of research relying on this definitive dataset and analyses used to guide the distribution of over $1.5 trillion in annual federal spending.

translated_title: 美国人口普查去噪：简洁的分块层次回归
translated_abstract: 2020年美国人口普查采用差分隐私来保护个人隐私，在汇总的人口统计测量数据中加入校准噪声，再将这些数据调和成人口表格。我们开发了BlueDown，这是一种后处理算法，结合了线性回归和约束优化的技术，同时利用测量数据的结构以提高效率。在2020年人口普查数据上，BlueDown将县级按种族分组数据的误差降低了21-36%，将所有县级分组数据的误差降低了9-58%；在普查区层面，它将按住房类型分组数据的误差降低了38-61%。这些改进没有以牺牲隐私保护或计算效率为代价，将提高依赖这一权威数据集的研究以及用于指导每年超过1.5万亿美元联邦支出分配的分析的有效性。
tldr: BlueDown是一种结合线性回归与约束优化的后处理算法，能在不牺牲隐私保护或计算效率的前提下，显著降低2020年美国人口普查差分隐私噪声造成的分组数据误差。
en_tdlr: BlueDown is a postprocessing algorithm combining linear regression and constrained optimization that significantly reduces errors from differential privacy noise in the 2020 US Census without sacrificing confidentiality or computational efficiency.
